user.title: Add a Devialet Expert amplifier
user.description:
Amplifiers found by the local network scan: {found}.

Pick a detected amplifier, or choose "Enter an address manually below" and type its IP address or hostname. The volume limits set the dB range exposed through the Home Assistant volume slider.

data_description.device: Detected amplifiers on this network. Choose manual entry if yours is not listed.
data_description.host: Used only when manual entry is selected, or when no amplifier was detected.
data_description.volume_min_db: 0% on the Home Assistant volume slider. -97.5 dB is the quietest value the amplifier can report.
data_description.volume_max_db: 100% on the Home Assistant volume slider. Values above -10 dB are very loud; the default limit stays at -10 dB, matching the upstream DeviMote safety clamp.

reconfigure.title: Update Devialet Expert settings
reconfigure.description: Enter the amplifier's current IP address or hostname, which is useful after a DHCP address change, and adjust the volume limits.

data_description.host: The amplifier must be reachable on the same local network and broadcasting status packets.
data_description.volume_min_db: 0% on the Home Assistant volume slider. -97.5 dB is the quietest value the amplifier can report.
data_description.volume_max_db: 100% on the Home Assistant volume slider. Values above -10 dB are very loud; the default limit stays at -10 dB, matching the upstream DeviMote safety clamp.

error.cannot_connect: No Devialet status broadcast was received from this address within the listening window. Check the address, that the amplifier is powered, and that UDP port 45454 reaches Home Assistant.
error.host_required: Enter an IP address or hostname, or select a detected amplifier.
error.invalid_volume_range: The minimum volume must be lower than the maximum volume.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The Devialet Expert settings were updated.
